mapper.select: SELECT l.* FROM library_entries l JOIN books b ON b.id=l.book_id WHERE l.user_id=#{userId} AND b.status='completed' AND b.visibility='public' AND b.moderation_status IN ('unreviewed','approved') AND b.asset_scope IN ('private','verified-shared') ORDER BY l.updated_at DESC,l.book_id LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM library_entries l JOIN books b ON b.id=l.book_id WHERE l.user_id=#{userId} AND b.status='completed' AND b.visibility='public' AND b.moderation_status IN ('unreviewed','approved') AND b.asset_scope IN ('private','verified-shared')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO library_entries(user_id,book_id,shelf_state,created_at,updated_at) VALUES(#{userId},#{bookId},#{shelfState},#{createdAt},#{updatedAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE shelf_state=#{shelfState},updated_at=#{updatedAt}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM library_entries WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND book_id=#{bookId}
